<td class="text"><p id="xdx_805_eus-gaap--SubsequentEventsTextBlock_z3BeZE6fQhx6" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>NOTE 13: <span id="xdx_82C_zMhJyiPOfARb">SUBSEQUENT EVENTS</span></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company has evaluated all events that
occurred after the condensed consolidated balance sheet date through the date when the condensed consolidated financial statements
were issued, September 28, 2026, to determine if they must be reported.&#160;&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><i>Receipt of Tariff Refund</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Subsequent to June 30, 2026, the Company received
$<span id="xdx_90F_ecustom--RefundReceived_pp0d_c20260701__20260928__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zMku9g0bvoe6" title="Refund received">1,823,401</span> of refunds of previously paid IEEPA tariffs. See Note 11.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><i>Effective Registration Statement</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company&#8217;s Form for Registration of Securities
on Form 10, as filed with the Securities and Exchange Committee on July 24, 2026, was declared effective on August 12, 2026. Upon our
registration statement being deemed effective, we will be subject to the requirements of Regulation 13A under the Exchange Act, which
will require us to file annual reports on Form 10-K, quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, and current reports on Form 8-K.</p>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>The entire disclosure for significant events or transactions that occurred after the balance sheet date through the date the financial statements were issued or the date the financial statements were available to be issued. Examples include: the sale of a capital stock issue, purchase of a business, settlement of litigation, catastrophic loss, significant foreign exchange rate changes, loans to insiders or affiliates, and transactions not in the ordinary course of business.</p></div>
